protocol.scope: Strict new event-combination transfer. Refit only archived P11 training groups; exclude every multi-event condition including repaired combinations and anchors. Test all P13 with pre-stream data. No outcome-dependent model choice.
protocol.reference_checks: Family reference tables identical between sampled blocks/gaps/repair. No physical COM inputs. Clock and source weights fixed from earlier engineering validation.
protocol.limitations: Method structure designed with familiarity with all stages; this is retrospective executed holdout evidence, not prospective validation. Frozen neural controller source is available by assumption.
protocol.baseline_scope: Give baselines the same P11 single-event trajectory outcomes and P13 single-event history. Continuous labels and censor flags separated.

fit.interpretation: effective empirical coefficients, not identified exact physical mass/inertia or causal omission attribution

accounting_revision: Score height from predicted LP z at original common first-event time13.255, matching the archived task metric. Raw traces unchanged; column7 is LP z. Earlier pre-stream-origin scores preserved separately.
